description: Custom patterns for duplicate code detection. Add your own patterns here.

initUserDb + jsonError.suggestion: Consider a trait or base class method that combines these checks

requireLogin guard.suggestion: Already a pattern, but could use middleware/attribute

Bean findOne + not found check.suggestion: Use Bean::findOneOrFail() that throws on not found

R:: instead of Bean:: for user DB.suggestion: Use Bean:: wrapper for user database tables (ensures lowercase normalization)

Direct R::exec for CRUD.suggestion: Use bean operations (Bean::dispense/store/trash) instead of raw SQL for CRUD

try-catch with logger.suggestion: Standard pattern, but consider a withErrorHandling() wrapper

Hardcoded tenant check.suggestion: Avoid hardcoding tenant slugs, use config or constants

Manual CSRF token access.suggestion: Use Flight::csrf()->validateRequest() instead of manual token access

tenant_slug usage (refactor to workspace.suggestion: TODO: Refactor 'tenant' to 'workspace' for consistency with user-facing terminology

Hyphenated route endpoints.suggestion: Use camelCase for route endpoints (e.g., updateStory not update-story)
